item.text:
**Assessment:** mostly yes. The record I found is largely anti-capture and pro-transparency: Scholz backed disclosure reforms, public accountability, anti-arbitrage tax coordination, and investigation/prosecution when misconduct surfaced. The main counterweight is that I did **not** find a direct 2024 corruption scandal tied to Scholz personally; the negative material is mostly structural opacity and late-year political instability, not favoritism or oligarchic capture.

|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Support | The cabinet approved changes to implement the "executive footprint" and "synopsis" | Bundesregierung | 2024-03-06 | https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/aktuelles/bundeskabinett-ergebnisse-2263572 | The cabinet adopted procedural changes that improve traceability of executive drafting and influence. That is a concrete anti-capture / transparency reform, useful against hidden lobbying or favoritism. | 5B.5, 4B.10 |
| Support | German Stability Programme 2024 adopted | Federal Government | 2024-04-24 | https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/aktuelles/stable-financial-policy-2273918 | Scholz’s government said it was returning to debt-brake compliance while still investing in future growth. This is not a corruption item per se, but it supports a rules-based governing style rather than patronage. | 5B.5, 5B.3 |
| Support | Scholz calls for completion of EU capital markets union | Reuters | 2024-01-28 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy/germanys-scholz-calls-for-completion-of-eu-capital-markets-union-3285303 | Scholz argued for a completed banking/capital-markets union and a minimum corporate tax to reduce low-tax arbitrage. That is direct evidence against favoring connected firms through opaque tax advantages. | 5B.5, 5B.4 |

This indicates pro-entrepreneurship rule-setting rather than oligarchic privilege. | 5B.5, 5B.4 |
| Support | German cabinet approves measures for better access to capital markets | Reuters | 2024-11-27 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/german-cabinet-approves-measures-for-better-access-to-capital-markets-3744243 | The cabinet approved reforms to improve venture-capital taxation, remove obstacles to infrastructure and renewable-energy investment, and cut bureaucracy. This is strong evidence of broad, non-favoritist market reform. | 5B.5, 5B.4 |

That is due-process language rather than protection of politically connected actors. | 5B.5, 4B.8 |
| Support | Scholz praised independent journalism, investigative reporting, and critical distance | Bundesregierung | 2024-06-03 | https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/newsletter-und-abos/bulletin/scholz-journalistenschule-2290636 | Scholz explicitly framed investigative reporting and critical distance as central to democracy. This is relevant because independent media are a key constraint on corruption and capture. | 5B.5, 4B.10 |

This is a structural negative for clean governance, though not proof of Scholz’s personal favoritism or capture. | 5B.5, 4B.9, 4B.10 |
| Counterweight | Scholz fired Lindner, collapsing the coalition | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-11-06 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/explainergerman-coalition-collapses-what-comes-next-3706936 | The coalition collapse worsened uncertainty and delayed policy continuity. That is not evidence of corruption, but it weakens the practical environment for clean, predictable rule-making. | 5B.5, 4B.10, 5B.3 |
| Counterweight | Scholz loses no-confidence vote, paving way for election | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-12-16 | https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/german-chancellor-scholz-loses-no-confidence-vote-paving-way-for-election-3773234 | Year-end governing instability undercut continuity and predictability. Again, this is a stability counterweight, not direct evidence of favoritism or oligarchic capture. | 5B.5, 4B.10, 5B.3 |

Search gap: I did **not** find reliable 2024 evidence of Scholz personally using state power to reward business cronies, monopolists, or connected oligarchs, or of a major corruption scandal tied to his office. The available evidence is mostly **pro-transparency and anti-arbitrage**, with the main negatives being **confidential process choices** and **late-2024 political instability**, not direct capture.
